rows.name: a drag is staged in 'drags' mode (cin p, queue place, origin kept), a tap is not
GM without preview: the staged stroke is not on the display (0 groups, 0 pixels), the tap is
GM preview ON: the GM sees it at once (pixels)
undo removes the last staged stroke (the counter drops by one)
redo brings it back still staged (cin p, hidden)
a staged carry: tk kept, the token has NOT moved (document) after 3.5 s
Action: a show record with both staged strokes in queue order
the show played: every staged stroke settled as d, flags gone, counter 0
entries started exactly on the shared schedule
the carried token moved for real at the end of its stroke's play
kill switch: the staged stroke shows at once, the counter is 0, a new drag is not staged
